name: BSP_Startup_ResolveLanguage
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. thiscall, ECX is an out native string (008f8322 LEA ECX,[ESP+0xc]); returns this in EAX; RET 0. Seeds the string with 'english' (0041e870), builds <CSIDL_PERSONAL>\Battlestations-Pacific\options.txt via SHGetSpecialFolderPathA(5,fCreate=1) and the concat at 004261a0, and fopen(...,'rt'). On success the file is read into a memory backing and tokenised; a token matching 'Language' (00d15f1c, compare 00438e10) makes the next token the value (008f8070..008f808b). On fopen failure only, HKLM\SOFTWARE\Eidos\Battlestations Pacific value 'language' is read and, if REG_DWORD, mapped 0x407 german / 0x40a spanish / 0x40c french / 0x410 italian / default english (switch 008f7f9c). docs/WINMAIN_STARTUP.md

name: BSP_WinMain
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. stdcall(HINSTANCE, HINSTANCE, LPSTR, int) from the CRT at 00bfd0dd; both exits are XOR EAX,EAX / RET 10h, so the process exit code is always 0 and none of the four arguments is ever read (no frame access above the return address). Sequence: CoInitializeEx(0, COINIT_APARTMENTTHREADED) then CoInitializeSecurity(NULL,-1,NULL,NULL,RPC_C_AUTHN_LEVEL_NONE,RPC_C_IMP_LEVEL_IMPERSONATE,NULL,0,NULL); on success CoCreateInstance(CLSID_GameExplorer 9a5ea990-3034-4d6f-9128-01f3c61022bc, CLSCTX_ALL, IID_IGameExplorer e7b2fb72-d728-49b3-a5f2-18eb f5f1349e); GetCurrentDirectoryA(0xbfe) plus '\battlestationspacific.exe' is widened by 004c5e60 and passed to IGameExplorer::VerifyAccess (vtable +18h); a FALSE result calls CRT exit(0) at 008f82ee before Release and CoUninitialize. Both COM-init failure branches still reach CoUninitialize. Then BSP_RandomThreads_Initialize, a one byte slot allocation gating BSP_RandomThreads_RegisterCurrent, and CreateMutexA(NULL, TRUE, 'MidwayThreadMutex'). A non-null handle with GetLastError()==ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS takes the already-running path: BSP_Startup_ResolveLanguage, a localized MessageBoxW (MB_ICONHAND) chosen by 00425850 comparisons, free of the language buffer, return 0 without closing the mutex or shutting the random subsystem down. Otherwise SetThreadAffinityMask(GetCurrentThread(),1), BSP_GameResourceFactory_GetSingleton stored to 00f8d31c, then on one 0x1c byte stack object BSP_Application_Construct, BSP_Application_Initialize(0,'cachedload'), BSP_Platform_RunLoopDispatch, BSP_Application_Shutdown, BSP_Application_Destruct; teardown destroys and frees the singleton manager at 01090aa0 and clears it, CloseHandle, unregister and free the thread slot, BSP_RandomThreads_Shutdown unconditionally. The Ghidra pseudocode aliases the COM out pointer with the language string object and wrongly returns inside the 01090aa0 branch. docs/WINMAIN_STARTUP.md | Packet orch3_startup_language_l: bounded008F832B..008F83BE message selector now accepts the actual8-byte native header and uses canonical00425850 for the same five fixed nonnull literals in original AL-test order. Header identity from008F8322/008F7DD6 is preserved by the new API; native release reloads current header only after MessageBoxW. Existing std::string runtime has no actual resolver owner and retains explicitly documented C-string projection. Same message selection on this subset; no startup bug or full00425850 trace equivalence claimed. Misleading private helper removed. Strict Win32/2CTests/8seed checks and8case ignored source fixture passed; 148fragment bytes match live Ghidra and disk. docs/STARTUP_LANGUAGE_BINDING.md; reports/startup_language_binding.json. No full WinMain/SEH/allocator or game closure. | Correction from docs/STARTUP_COM_BINDING.md: 008F81F8 PUSH8 means COINIT_MULTITHREADED|COINIT_SPEED_OVER_MEMORY, not apartment-threaded; security auth level0 is DEFAULT, not NONE(1). Actual SDK Game Explorer CoCreateInstance/VerifyAccess/Release now bound in src/game_hosts.cpp. Native independent pointer release guard after negative HRESULT, uninitialized output BOOL and ignored VerifyAccess HRESULT preserved. BFBDBB(code) calls BFBCD9(code,0,0), reverse on-exit table/full cleanup, so host uses genuine std::exit. Actual MTA, COM security, Game Explorer access query and atexit callback checked in isolated processes. This closes bounded process bindings, not original ABI, pooled wide-string ownership, whole WinMain or gameplay. Descriptive name remains a hypothesis.
